intent: Create a Sentinel monitoring system with two agent types: (1) Plan Sentinel - per-plan monitor that subscribes to SSE events, watches task states/wave progress/failures, and can intervene (retry, pause, escalate) using LLM-powered reasoning with rule-based guardrails, (2) System Sentinel - singleton that monitors all services (orchestration API, context store, Postgres, Ollama), tracks cross-plan resource contention, spawns/supervises Plan Sentinels, and persists observations to context store. Both agents communicate via in-process async message bus and persist durable state to context store as sentinel_observation nodes. Intervention tiers: Auto (retry, release claims), Supervised (skip task, reorder wave - needs user approval), Escalate (cancel plan, blow budget). Integration points: ProgressManager SSE events, ResourceMonitor health checks, orchestration API for task/plan mutations, context store API for observation persistence and incident knowledge base.
